privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.description: Scheduled videos stay private until their publish time.

madeForKids.label: Made for kids
madeForKids.description: Required by law. Comments and personalised ads are turned off on kids content.

containsSyntheticMedia.label: Altered or synthetic content
containsSyntheticMedia.description: Discloses realistic content made with AI or otherwise altered.

notifySubscribers.label: Notify subscribers
notifySubscribers.description: Send the upload to the subscription feeds of your subscribers.

hashtagsInDescription.label: Add hashtags to the description
hashtagsInDescription.description: Shows the first three above the title. Without this they stay hidden keywords.

embeddable.label: Allow embedding
embeddable.description: Other sites may embed the video in their pages.

publicStatsViewable.label: Public stats visible
publicStatsViewable.description: Show the view count on the watch page.

madeWithAi.label: Made with AI
madeWithAi.description: Labels the post as generated or heavily edited with AI.

paidPartnership.label: Paid partnership
paidPartnership.description: Discloses that the post is sponsored content.

superFollowersOnly.label: Subscribers only
superFollowersOnly.description: Only your paying subscribers can see the post.

shareToFeed.label: Also share to feed
shareToFeed.description: The reel appears on your profile grid as well as in the Reels tab.

creator.notConnected: Connect a TikTok account in Settings to choose these options.
creator.unavailable: TikTok did not answer. Reload the page to try again.
creator.tooLong: This account can post videos up to {{seconds}} seconds long. Shorten the video or turn TikTok off.
creator.turnedOff: Turned off in your TikTok settings.

privacy.label: Who can watch
privacy.description: Choose for every post. TikTok offers only what this account allows.

disableComment.label: Disable comments
disableComment.description: Nobody can comment under the video.

disableDuet.label: Disable duet
disableDuet.description: Stops others from posting their video side by side with yours.

disableStitch.label: Disable stitch
disableStitch.description: Stops others from clipping part of your video into their own.

isAigc.label: AI-generated content
isAigc.description: TikTok labels the video as created with AI.

discloseContent.label: Disclose video content
discloseContent.description: Turn on if the video promotes a brand, a product or a service.

brandOrganic.label: Your brand
brandOrganic.description: You are promoting yourself or your own business.

brandContent.label: Branded content
brandContent.description: You are promoting another brand or a third party. Cannot be private.

disclosure.promotional: Your video will be labeled "Promotional content".
disclosure.paidPartnership: Your video will be labeled "Paid partnership".
disclosure.chooseOne: Choose at least one of the two.

consent.music: By posting, you agree to TikTok's <music>Music Usage Confirmation</music>.
consent.withBrandedContent: By posting, you agree to TikTok's <branded>Branded Content Policy</branded> and <music>Music Usage Confirmation</music>.

coverFrame.label: Cover frame
coverFrame.description: Seconds into the video to use as the cover. 0 keeps the first frame.
